description: This file contains utility functions for verifying and logging the URL resolution of the /api/users endpoint within a frontend project's API layer. It includes functions to construct the URL based on organization context, simulate specific organization scenarios, and perform runtime checks and logs for debugging purposes.

methods.name: verifyUsersUrlResolution(organizationIdOverride = null)
methods.description: Constructs and logs the expected URL for the /api/users endpoint, optionally overriding the organization ID for testing purposes, and verifies query parameters in debug mode.

methods.name: quickUsersResolutionSmoke()
methods.description: A helper function that calls verifyUsersUrlResolution with a specific test organization ID ('T0015') to demonstrate URL resolution behavior, primarily for development or testing diagnostics.
